name: Avatar
description: A person or organization as an image, initials or an icon. Without an image it shows the initials of name in a color picked from a stable hash of the name; without a name, an icon. An image sits over the initials, so a broken image falls back to them.

livewire.name: avatar
capabilities: Group: avatar-group overlaps a row of avatars, from avatar children or avatars data with max
The 2.x image and placeholder attributes still map to src and name, deprecated

react.name: Avatar
capabilities: Group: AvatarGroup overlaps a row of avatars, from Avatar children or avatars data with max

vue.name: Avatar
capabilities: Group: AvatarGroup overlaps a row of avatars, from Avatar children or avatars data with max

props.name: name
props.description: The person's or organization's full name. It gives the initials (first and last word), the accessible name and the hashed color.
props.a11y: Names the role=img root. Without name or alt the avatar is decorative and aria-hidden.

props.name: src
props.description: The image URL. Only relative, http, https and data:image URLs are used. It covers the initials, which show through when it fails to load.

props.name: alt
props.description: The accessible name when it should differ from name, such as "Apexify logo".

props.name: initials
props.description: Overrides the initials taken from name, such as "+4" for an overflow avatar.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon name shown instead of initials, resolved through the icon registry. Without a name or initials the avatar shows user.

props.name: size
props.description: Matches the control heights: 24, 28, 36, 44 or 52px. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: shape
props.description: circle for people, square for organizations and workspaces. Emitted as data-shape.

props.name: color
props.description: The initials' tone. Defaults to a color picked from a stable hash of name (sum of its code points over primary, secondary, accent, success, warning, error and info), and neutral without a name. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: status
props.description: A presence dot at the end corner. Emitted on the status part as data-status.
props.a11y: Also announced in the accessible name through statusLabel, so color is not the only signal.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: The words for the status, added to the accessible name: "Olivia Rhye (Online)". Defaults to Online, Away or Offline; translate it. Livewire defaults it through __().

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { image: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The avatar, role=img with the person's name.

parts.name: image
parts.description: The image, over the initials. Decorative (alt=""): the root carries the name.

parts.name: initials
parts.description: Up to two letters from name, or initials. Decorative.

parts.name: status
parts.description: The presence dot. Decorative; the status is in the accessible name.

requirements: The root is role=img named by alt or name, plus the status in words; the image, initials, icon and dot inside it are decorative.
Without a name or alt the avatar is decorative: aria-hidden, no role.
Initials keep 4.5:1 on their soft fill in every theme.
Status is announced in text (statusLabel), never by color alone; the dot has a 2px ring in the surface color.
In a group each avatar is ringed in the surface color (--apui-focus-ring-offset-color).
In forced colors the avatar keeps an edge and the dot is CanvasText.
